name: kindle-reader
description: Read EPUB, FB2 and PDF books with realistic page flips, highlights, notes, and reading progress synced with your vault.

scripts.build: cross-env PLUGIN_DIR=vault/.obsidian/plugins/kindle-reader node esbuild.config.mjs production && node patch-pdfjs.cjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Bernardo
